team.title: Team
team.lead: Everyone who tracks time in this account, their role and weekly capacity.
team.name: Name
team.noActive: Invite the first person to start tracking time together.
team.noDeactivated: People you deactivate keep their history and are listed here.

roleHints.admin: Sees and changes everything, including account settings, rates and people.
roleHints.manager: Manages projects and approves time for the people on them.
roleHints.member: Tracks their own time and expenses on the projects they're assigned to.

team.capacityHint: Hours a week they're available, e.g. 40 or 32:30.
team.billableRateHint: Per hour. Used on projects billed by person.
team.costRateHint: Per hour. What their time costs you, for profitability reports.
team.perHour: Per hour. Leave empty for no rate.
team.futureProjectsHint: They're assigned to every new project automatically.
team.sendInviteHint: They get an email with a link to join. Leave this off to add them now and invite them later.
team.invitedOn: Invited on {{date}}. They can sign in once they accept.
team.notInvitedYet: Not invited yet. They can't sign in until you send the invitation.
team.teamsLead: Group people to filter reports, e.g. Design or Engineering. Teams don't change what anyone can see or do.
team.noTeams: No teams yet. Create one to filter reports by group.
team.deleteTeamConfirm: Delete the team "{{name}}"? The people in it stay in the account; only the grouping is removed.
team.noOneToPick: Invite people first, then add them to teams.
team.hiddenMembers_one: {{count}} deactivated person also stays in this team.
team.hiddenMembers_other: {{count}} deactivated people also stay in this team.
team.emailLocked: They've signed in, so they change their email themselves.
team.contractorHint: Someone you pay for their time rather than employ.
team.billableDefaultHint: Their time counts as billable on projects that bill by person.
team.ratesLead: In the account currency. Time already tracked keeps the rates it was saved with until you update it.
team.adminPermissions: Admins can see and change everything in this account.
team.managerPermissionsLead: Managers approve time and see reports for the projects they manage.
team.memberPermissionsLead: Members see only their own time and expenses.
team.canSeeRatesHint: Billable and cost rates, amounts and budgets in money.
team.canManageProjectsHint: Also clients and tasks. Without this they manage only the projects they're made manager of.
team.canManageInvoicesHint: Create and send invoices and record payments.
team.personTeamsLead: Teams only group people for filtering reports.
team.deactivateLead: Deactivated people can't sign in and no longer count as a seat. Their time, expenses and history are kept.
team.deactivateBody: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in to this account and won't count as a seat. Their time, expenses and history are kept, any running timer is stopped, and you can reactivate them at any time.
team.reactivateLead: {{name}} is deactivated. Their history is kept. Reactivate them to let them sign in and track time again.
team.cantDeactivateSelf: You can't deactivate yourself. Ask another admin.
team.readOnly: Only account admins can change people's details.
team.staleBody_one: {{count}} uninvoiced entry still uses the old rates. Update it to the new rates?
team.staleBody_other: {{count}} uninvoiced entries still use the old rates. Update them to the new rates?
team.staleKept: Invoiced and approved time keeps the rates it was saved with.
team.notFound: This person doesn't exist or you can't see them.
team.sendInviteHintNoEmail: This server can't send email yet, so you get a link to send them yourself.
team.linkBody: This server can't send email yet, so send this link to {{name}} yourself, for example in a chat. Anyone with the link can join as {{name}}, so send it only to them. It works until {{date}}.

seats.costWhenAccepted: When {{name}} accepts, you pay for them: {{price}}. That day, Paddle charges for what's left of your current billing period, up to {{unit}}. Nothing is charged before they accept.
seats.costNow: Once {{name}} is back, you pay for them: {{price}}. Today, Paddle charges for what's left of your current billing period, up to {{unit}}.
seats.periodEnds: Your current billing period ends on {{date}}.
seats.stale: The price is different from the one shown before. This is the price now.
seats.freeFull_one: The free plan is for one person. For more people to sign in, start a Team subscription.
seats.freeFull_other: The free plan is for {{count}} people. For more people to sign in, start a Team subscription.
seats.perPerson: You pay for each person who can sign in. An invitation is free until it's accepted.

option.year: Yearly: {{price}} per person per month, paid yearly ({{total}} a year)

seats.atCheckout_one: Checkout counts {{count}} person who can sign in: {{total}}. Paddle shows the amount before you pay.
seats.atCheckout_other: Checkout counts {{count}} people who can sign in: {{total}}. Paddle shows the amount before you pay.
seats.waitingInvitations_one: {{count}} invitation is waiting. Starting Team is your yes to it: once it's accepted, you pay for that person too, {{price}}, and that day Paddle charges for what's left of the billing period.
seats.waitingInvitations_other: {{count}} invitations are waiting. Starting Team is your yes to them: as each is accepted, you pay for that person too, {{price}}, and that day Paddle charges for what's left of the billing period.
seats.waiting: Thanks! You can go ahead as soon as Paddle confirms your subscription.
seats.ready: Your Team subscription is active. Try again to go ahead.
